message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on June 18, 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 casualties** in total. This figure includes those killed, wounded, and missing from both sides:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allied forces (including German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These numbers are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical analyses; exact counts vary slightly among sources.
